title: UG-033 — Begin survey design from the intended results
intent: Convert an EUSurvey best-practice recommendation into a practical KB article.
short_answer: Before creating a survey, define why the survey is needed, who will work with it, what data is required, what will be done with the results and how the results should be presented.
important_conditions: This recommendation comes from the EUSurvey best-practices guidance.
related_articles: UG-042 — Keep surveys short and simple
UG-051 — Test the survey before publishing
